Antipsychotics may cause somnolence, postural hypotension, motor
and sensory instability, which may lead to falls; for patients with
diseases, conditions, or medications that could exacerbate these
effects, complete fall risk assessments when initiating antipsychotic
treatment, and recurrently for patients on long-term antipsychotic
therapy
As with any antipsychotic, use with caution in patients with history

If patient suffers from extreme hypertension/hypotension
If there is a history of QTc prolongation or cardiac arrhythmia,

If patient is taking drugs that inhibit thioridazine metabolism,

If there is reduced CYP450 2D6 function, such as in patients who
